caveats: This is a planned lane with zero published cells; it reports no winner, lift, mechanism success, or release decision.
The cohort labels are public plan boundaries, not frozen task IDs. Exact task, source, route, runtime, Skill, and integration locks remain pending.
Discovery and private holdout require separate approvals, and only a discovery-selected arm may enter the holdout.
The active execution backend is local Harbor; no Serverless behavior is claimed.
hypothesis: At least one mechanism-backed intervention will produce a paired deterministic discovery gain without a critical private-holdout regression.
question: Can a reviewed Skill change, MCP change, or their combination repair a locked Claude Code evidence failure and retain the gain on independent private tasks?
summary: A planned local-Harbor Study that compares four reviewed Skill and MCP arms on two discovery failures, locks one intervention, and then compares it with production on four private holdout tasks.
task_selection: Two reviewed failures form the discovery cohort; four independent private tasks form the holdout. Exact task identities and digests are not public until a preview is frozen and separately approved.
title: Claude Code Skill × MCP loop
why_it_matters: The flagship Fugue loop should demonstrate that Claude Code can engineer a bounded Agent improvement while Fugue keeps approval, execution, evaluation, selection, and evidence authority outside the Agent.
